decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green devotion cards and mana dorks, while also aggressively putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Outcaster Trailblazer and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also aims to generate value by casting powerful spells like Storm the Festival and having access to cards like Boseiju, Who Endures for added resilience. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and powerful spells fueled by green mana devotion.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures like Unstoppable Slasher and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal damage early, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to clear the way. Thoughtseize and Duress disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Blightstep Pathway and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value. The deck also features powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. With a solid mana base and a proactive game plan, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with speed and efficiency.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the deck features cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The focus of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by using Azorius spirits along with cards that provide protection and disruption. The key strategy revolves around utilizing Mausoleum Wanderer, Spell Queller, and Supreme Phantom to pressure the opponent while also countering their spells. The inclusion of cards like Skyclave Apparition and Brazen Borrower allow for removal and additional disruption. Overall, the deck aims to establish a board presence quickly and maintain control of the game through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven, the deck can trigger powerful effects that ping the opponent and their creatures. Additionally, cards like Fatal Push provide removal options while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for card draw and recursion. By efficiently managing resources and sacrificing creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with constant pressure and value.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, along with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance ensures that the pressure remains high throughout the game, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also disrupting their hand with Duress. The deck also focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. The deck benefits from sacrificing creatures with Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to gain additional value. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with aggressive creatures and using Collected Company to generate card advantage and put pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value by blinking creatures and generating more triggers. The mana base is built to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of green and white sources to ensure consistency in casting the deck's numerous creatures and spells. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Skyclave Apparition and Voice of Resurgence to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the aggro creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressive, low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key idea is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while also using burn spells like Infuriate, Reckless Rage, and Fatal Push to clear the way and finish off the opponent. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach for the deck, allowing for direct damage to the opponent even if the board is stalled. The goal is to close out the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of cheap and aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, backed up by powerful instant spells like Infuriate and Reckless Rage. The deck aims to quickly reduce your opponent's life total while maintaining pressure on the board with cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Screaming Nemesis. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with fast lands and utility lands like Den of the Bugbear. Overall, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure and finish the game quickly.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence with creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, allowing for early aggression. Collected Company provides additional creature advantage, while Skyclave Apparition can deal with problematic threats from the opponent. The deck also includes some flexibility with cards like Knight of Autumn for additional utility.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using devotion to green cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Old-Growth Troll, in order to cast powerful threats such as Cavalier of Thorns and Storm the Festival. By utilizing cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves for additional mana acceleration, this aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big creatures in the early to mid game. With support from Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Wolfwillow Haven, the goal is to maintain pressure and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This aggressive red deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and dealing damage to opponent creatures and face. Utilizing low-cost creatures like Ghitu Lavarunner and Monastery Swiftspear, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Skewer the Critics, the deck aims to control the battlefield and push through damage with Monstrous Rage and Slickshot Show-Off. The inclusion of cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional sources of damage output. The deck's strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and direct damage spells to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient removal spells and discard effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying aggressive threats. The key strategy is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with low-cost creatures and deal damage before they can stabilize. The deck also has some synergy with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Blade of the Oni to generate additional value. Overall, the goal is to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle using a mix of creatures and direct damage spells. The deck aims to quickly build up a board presence with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while using spells like Reckless Rage and Infuriate to clear the way and deal direct damage. Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provide additional threats and value, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize and turn the game in their favor.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. By efficiently using spells like Atarka's Command and Monstrous Rage, along with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, the deck aims to apply early pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. With a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures, it aims to win the game quickly through aggression and efficient use of resources.
